results.evidence: The nephron is the filtration unit of the kidney.
Glucose is broken down in the cytoplasm to release energy.
Pyruvate is the three-carbon molecule formed when glucose is broken down.
The three-carbon molecule is broken down completely in the mitochondria using oxygen.

grading_basis: Deterministic string comparison, NO MODEL. The answer is folded (lowercased, accents stripped, punctuation and articles removed, whitespace collapsed) and compared to the folded target: equal folds are CORRECT; otherwise difflib similarity >= 0.82 or a token-set containment >= 0.75 is PARTIAL; anything else is INCORRECT. A learner is never told they are wrong by a generative model, and the same answer is graded the same way on every machine and every rerun. It cannot judge a paraphrase that shares no words with the target — that is a real limit of a deterministic grader and it is reported as PARTIAL-eligible rather than hidden.
